summary: MainStreet Bancshares furnished an Item 8.01 8-K on August 21, 2026 announcing its board declared the regular quarterly cash dividend on its 7.50% Series A Fixed-Rate Non-Cumulative Perpetual Preferred Stock. The dividend equals $18.75 per Series A preferred share, or roughly $0.47 per depositary share (each a 1/40th interest), payable September 30, 2026 to holders of record September 15, 2026. No special-situations event, transaction, stake, price, or advisor is involved; this is a routine dividend declaration on the MNSBP-listed depositary shares.
